message: Provide an authentication scheme using the `@useAuth` decorator. See: https://azure.github.io/typespec-azure/docs/reference/azure-style-guide#security-definitions
Azure services should not use the enum keyword. Extensible enums should be defined as unions with "string" as an accepted variant (ex: `union Choice { Yes: "yes", No: "no", string };`).
Operation is missing an api version parameter.
GET operations that return single objects should start with 'get'
Operation 'read' should be defined using a signature from the Azure.Core namespace.
